name: kofad-native-desktop
description: Native Windows desktop clients for KOFAD Market and KOFAD Staff

scripts.dist:customer: cross-env KOFAD_NATIVE_CHANNEL=customer node scripts/guard-release.cjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config build.config.cjs --publish never
